Sleeping Fault.name: Sleeping Fault
Sleeping Fault.description: The user grips a door, a vehicle, a weapon or a beam and plants the decay without letting it act. It waits in the material for up to an hour and crumbles that object the instant the user wills it or a condition they set is met: a getaway van falls apart as its engine starts, a stolen gun turns to grit when drawn, never touching the hand that holds it. The user can plant a handful at once; each aches in the palm until spent or called back, that hand cannot decay anything meanwhile, and a forgotten plant still goes off. Strain: severe.
